metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you actually hit that?’ and enemy ragequitted
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that by accident?
My aim was definitely on break but hey, one kill’s better than none!
Click if your lucky shots make you question reality!
Valorant’s logic is wild, but I’m not complaining.

Tap if your aim’s more confused than your enemies!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
